source_zip.note: The working copy was unpacked into the project directory; the original ZIP was not overwritten.

gpc_target.positioning_decision: The paper is positioned as simulator-level burst-aware operational coupling for edge-cloud SFC orchestration; it does not claim information-theoretic privacy, distributed commit, or green/carbon optimization.

current_version.title: Limited-Visibility Burst-Aware SFC Orchestration in Edge--Cloud Networks

review_status.stopping_rule: Every reviewer in a five-reviewer round must score at least 9/10 and report no major blocker.

round_02.interpretation: All five independent reviews are complete. The final round mean is below the 9/10 stopping target, and theory, experiments/statistics, novelty/GPC, and artifact reviews still report major blockers.

changes_since_round_01.what_changed: Replaced burst-resilient/privacy/green overclaims with a narrower simulator-supported burst-aware operational claim; clarified that the work uses limited visibility and does not provide information-theoretic privacy, distributed commit, or energy/carbon optimization.

Added an explicit state-machine narrative, opaque token IDs, token-to-request/action/time/authorization binding, single-use consumption, cloud-stage authorization, final revalidation, non-rollback scale persistence, and negative fault responses.
changes_since_round_01.remaining_issue: The policy API still exposes the full mutable Environment and FlowSpec/TraceFlowSpec, so causal/filtration constraints are not enforced by the interface; the standalone token API also accepts fraction < 1 and can represent an incomplete allocation.

changes_since_round_01.what_changed: Removed future-peak access from threshold logic, introduced causal random_busy handling, and separated measured traces from declared causal traces.
changes_since_round_01.remaining_issue: The policy-facing API must still be refactored so the causal restriction is mechanically enforced rather than only documented.

changes_since_round_01.what_changed: Aligned split actions with the training action universe, removed duplicate actions per event, corrected Q-count reporting, and removed future burst-time access from training decisions.
The manuscript now reports external failure audits and empirical design desiderata rather than the previously unimplemented weighted optimization objective.
changes_since_round_01.remaining_issue: The development objective is computed before the external failure audit and therefore is not yet fully aligned with the switch_failure metric; Eq. 12 must be recomputed after the audit or removed.

changes_since_round_01.what_changed: Rebuilt canonical experiments and added seed-cluster reporting, crossed bootstrap learning comparisons, full factorial confirmation, causal/measured trace partitions, topology normal/stress runs, scale/failure runs, and explicit artifact provenance.
Fixed the Topology Zoo authorization-domain handling, rebuilt normal and stress outputs from current code, and added regression coverage.

Added a closest-work design-space table and narrowed the novelty statement to operational coupling among limited visibility, burst admission, tokenized feasibility, and edge-cloud stage authorization.
changes_since_round_01.remaining_issue: The PPDM row currently leaves the binary-response column as '--' even though the cited work uses binary response; the table needs a source-faithful correction and explicit mapping notes. Baseline names must also be labeled as common-simulator ports, not external implementations.

changes_since_round_01.what_changed: Rewrote the abstract/problem/algorithm/conclusion, replaced the evaluation synthesis, built a 15-page LNCS PDF, and performed visual/font/reference checks.
Created a frozen release manifest, locked PDF/log hashes, added manuscript-value synchronization, and ran canonical freeze/verify plus artifact tests.
changes_since_round_01.remaining_issue: A stale legacy report remains at sfc_autoresearch/experiment_results/canonical_gpc/integrity_report.json and records an older trace/PDF. It must be regenerated, renamed as legacy, or removed from the release path before the artifact claim is unambiguous.

topology_zoo_stress.interpretation: Stress results show a threshold boundary, not universal robustness.

remaining_blockers_before_next_review_ro: Hide future trace and full mutable environment state behind a restricted policy observation/action facade.
Reject or privatize any partial allocation path so the public action universe is complete and unit-sum.
Recompute the development objective after the external failure audit or remove the inconsistent Eq. 12 claim.
Correct the PPDM binary-response entry and add source-level mapping notes in the closest-work table.
Regenerate or clearly quarantine the stale local integrity report.
Complete the fifth-reviewer round with fresh GPC writing/PDF and artifact reviewers; only then use a round-level score.
Do not declare the GPC 9/10 stopping rule satisfied while any major blocker or missing reviewer remains.
